## 5. Engr. Erwin Balane

### 5.1 Identity and role (as shown in the 26-360 record only)

- **Erwin Hansol Balane**, "eldest child" (JA-E p.3 S10). The CTCs he requested show "ERWIN HANSOL BALANE" (DX1 footer; DX6 p.1 footer).
- **Residence:** Purok 1A, Brgy. San Roque (JA-E p.2). The subject lot is in Purok 4 (JA-P p.2). [INFERRED] He does not reside on the lot.
- **Office:** "Municipal Engineer ng bayan ng Mercedes" (JA-E p.2 S3).
- **The Complaint's allegations against him:**
  - acting "in conspiracy … using his official capacity … as the Municipal Engineer" (CMP p.4 ¶11);
  - "participating in the conduct and preparation of a subdivision plan … aiding with the issuance of the assailed tax declaration and Torrens title" (CMP p.8 ¶35).
- **The Answer's response:**
  - he is not a party to the deed and did not abuse his office (ANS p.2 ¶10);
  - tax declarations are not issued by the Municipal Engineer (ANS p.3 ¶26);
  - there is no cause of action against him (ANS p.5 ¶37).

### 5.2 Filings and positions

- **JA-E purposes** (p.1): no participation; as Municipal Engineer he had no authority over the deed, tax declaration or title; personal knowledge as eldest child.
- **Municipal Engineer role:**

- **Expected role as witness:** to rebut the accusations and show the "ordinary or ministerial nature of any acts" (ANS p.9 ¶59(e)).

### 5.5 Admissions and contradictions usable on cross

- **E1. Lessee origin.** "Umuupa lamang ang aming pamilya" (JA-E p.3 S11). This matches C1 and P1.
- **E2. Receipts: purchase or rent?**
  - He says the receipts prove long partial payments for the purchase (JA-E p.5 S21).
  - Answer ¶61 offers Exh. 5 "to prove rents paid and the installment or partial payments" (ANS p.10).
  - PB §2 describes 2007–2014 receipts marked "Occupant" [VERIFY].
- **E3. Custodian of the family papers versus the denial of the 002127 duplicate.**
  - S16: the documents are in his care while his parents are abroad (JA-E p.4).
  - The Answer denies the defendants hold the owner's duplicate of TCT 079-2021002127 (ANS pp.3–4 ¶¶24, 33).
  - He is the person with the knowledge to admit or deny where it is.
- **E4. "No participation" versus active document handling.** He requested the 2026 CTCs (DX1; DX6) and is the custodian (S16). This is limited to post-suit acts in the record; do not overstate.
- **E5. Personal knowledge.**
  - His account of the Llamanzares and Cesar dealings (S12–S14) is that of the eldest child; how old he was and whether he was present are not stated [VERIFY].
  - This is the same objection Ramos raised against Jonathan on 14 Oct (OVR).
- **E6. Office.**
  - The Answer says only that tax declarations are not issued by the Municipal Engineer (ANS p.3 ¶26).
  - It does not address building permits or the occupancy of structures on the lot.
  - Claude notes the Building Official function under PD 1096 §301 (PB §4) [VERIFY whether the Mercedes MEO is the designated Building Official; this is outside the record so far].
